chunks: From him, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about one who recites from the mushaf while he is without wudu (ablution). He said: There is no harm, but he should not touch the writing.

key_terms.الْمُصْحَفِ: the written codex of the Qur'an
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or prohibition
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: ritual ablution required for certain acts of worship

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to read the Qur'an from the mushaf without wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that reciting from the mushaf without wudu (ablution) is permissible. However, it prohibits touching the written text in that state, indicating a distinction in fiqh between recitation and physical contact with the Qur'anic script.
